title: Japanese Farmland Parcel Polygons
description:
Parcel information of Japanese farmland. 
The “筆ポリゴン” (Fude Polygon) data, provided by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), represents parcel information of farmland.
